usageNotes: Returns the list of pending APT package updates already cached on the node — this is a read of the local apt cache, not a live network refresh. Call `post_nodes_node_apt_update` first to refresh the cache if you need current results. The caller needs `Sys.Modify` on `/nodes/{node}`, so API tokens scoped only to VM operations will be denied.

examples.summary: List pending updates on node pve1

tips: Results reflect whatever apt last fetched; run `post_nodes_node_apt_update` (the POST variant) to trigger a live `apt-get update` before calling this.
Check the `Origin` field to distinguish Proxmox-specific packages (Origin: 'Proxmox') from upstream Debian packages — useful when deciding whether to delay updates pending PVE release notes.
NotifyStatus indicates the version for which PVE already sent an email/notification; if it matches Version the update is pending but the admin has already been alerted.
This endpoint is per-node — loop across all cluster nodes to get a full cluster-wide pending-update picture.
